# refactor current structure

A restructuring pass over the repository's build and layout:

```
- remove Taskfile
- review Makefile
- add new target to update git submodules
- prepare bin/* with lib/* integration
```

i.e. keep one task runner (the Makefile), give it a submodule-update target, and connect the standalone scripts in `bin/` with the function libraries in `bin/lib` so that the same code is not maintained twice.
